text:
marta_support: Customer ACME reports intermittent 502/504s on hosted generate/streaming since ~09:30 UTC. They see a bunch of client retries and some duplicate billing. Asking for quick triage and repro help.

marta_support: Sample from customer — short description: long streaming job (~30s), p95 spike then 502, client SDK retries, sometimes final 504. They included two request IDs: req_20260317_001 and req_20260317_009.

devon_engineer: Can you paste the exact SDK call + any headers they send? Also need the request IDs and approximate timestamps (to match traces).

marta_support: Pasted from customer:
```js
// node example (pseudo)
await client.chat.completions.stream({
  model: 'redwood/generate-v1',
  input: bigPrompt,
  stream: true,
  timeout: 45000,
  retry: { maxRetries: 4, backoff: 200 }
});
```
They say they use default auth token rotation and sometimes get a burst of refreshes. Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, `Connection: keep-alive`.

devon_engineer: Thanks. Do we have payload sizes / sequence lengths? That helps pick kernel path. Also are they streaming over HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2?

marta_support: Payloads ~20k chars. Customer reports HTTP/2 enabled in their env.

alex_oncall: HTTP/2 + many concurrent streams + token refresh fanout smells like connection reuse exhaustion on the edge. If token rotation triggers new auth for many connections at once, we can see 5xx cascades. Any auth-service errors around those req ids?

marta_support: I checked auth logs briefly — small spike of 429s from our token issuer at 09:30:12 UTC, correlates with the first 502s.

ingrid_prod: Could be request storm during token refresh. Short-term mitigation: reduce client concurrency or pin a cached token for a few seconds. We can also enable per-tenant circuit breaker and smaller inflight window for ACME.

devon_engineer: For immediate repro, I'll try to run a small script simulating HTTP/2 streaming with concurrent token refreshes. Could we get debug logs for the two request ids? Need gateway traces, edge LB, and runtime logs.

marta_support: Got the trace ids and pasted snippets:
```
[09:30:11] gateway: conn=87 request=req_20260317_001 -> downstream 502 upstream reset
[09:30:12] auth: token-issuer 429 slow-down (burst refresh)
[09:30:13] runtime: kvcache miss, kernel fallback, queue depth spike
```

alex_oncall: Kernel fallback + queue depth spike + auth fanout is a plausible chain. Short-term: route ACME to eu-west fallback pool which has more headroom for streaming and enable tenant-level 429-to-503 smoothing. Can support apply that?

marta_support: I asked the customer to accept a temporary migration. They approved. Applying now.

deploy-bot: config-change: route-update applied for tenant acme -> eu-west-fallback at 2026-03-17T09:45:22Z by marta_support (change-id: cfg_7731).

marta_support: After switching, customer reports 70% fewer 502s in the next 20 minutes but still sees occasional 504s on longer streams. Billing duplicates reduced.

devon_engineer: Good. Next steps: (1) reproduce locally with HTTP/2 streaming + aggressive token refresh to confirm root cause; (2) add extra guards in gateway to limit concurrent auth refreshes per-tenant; (3) review SDK default retry/backoff docs to avoid double-billing scenarios for streaming.

alex_oncall: Also check keepalive settings — mismatch between client and edge (short keepalive) can cause half-closed streams and reset behavior. Recommend adding an SDK example that sets `keepAlive: true` and an exponential backoff tuned for streaming.

marta_support: Customer already set `retry.maxRetries` to 4. They asked what to change. Any recommended config?

devon_engineer: For streaming, suggest `maxRetries: 2`, `backoffBase: 300`, and add jitter. Also prefer idempotency for non-streaming calls. We'll draft a short snippet for them.

ingrid_prod: I'll take ownership of the deeper investigation. I'll triage kernel fallback traces and LB metrics tomorrow morning and coordinate a small infra patch to smooth auth refresh fanout. Please open an ENG ticket and assign to `ingrid_prod`.

marta_support: Created ENG-5261 and assigned to ingrid_prod. Linked support ticket SUP-33890 and included traces + the customer's repro script.

alex_oncall: One more ask — increase debug retention for the tenant so we can catch the next incident. Also add a note to release doc about streaming retry behavior.

marta_support: Done. Retention bumped for SUP-33890 and a short customer comms draft is ready.

ingrid_prod: I'll pick this up in the morning. Thanks for the quick mitigation.

marta_support: Customer thanked us. They will keep us posted if it resurfaces and said the workaround is acceptable for now. :thumbsup:
